title.zh: Bitget因朝鲜相关黑客攻击损失3.88亿美元，CEO称资金追回希望渺茫
title.en: Bitget loses $388M in DPRK-linked hack; CEO sees slim odds of recovery

current_state.zh: 据报道，Bitget 在一次与朝鲜行为者有关的黑客攻击中损失了 3.88 亿美元，同一报道还质疑 Coinbase 是否也遭到了入侵。
current_state.en: Bitget reportedly lost $388 million in a hack linked to North Korean actors, with the same report questioning whether Coinbase was also breached.

updates.title_zh: Bitget CEO 认为追回 3.88 亿美元被盗资金的可能性渺茫
updates.title_en: Bitget CEO Sees Slim Odds of Recovering $388M Breach Funds
updates.what_changed_zh: Bitget CEO 表示，追回该交易所被盗的约 3.88 亿美元的机会很小，这暗示这些资金很可能无法追回。
updates.what_changed_en: Bitget's CEO said there is little chance of recovering the roughly $388 million lost in the exchange's breach, signaling the funds are likely unrecoverable.
